sessions.phase_label: Content editing, study-guide creation, image generation, and formatting

requirements.title: CHPN Tests 6–10 Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the CHPN tests numbered 6 through 10.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a distinct document-editing deliverable with its own completion trajectory; its delivery deadline is excluded from Requirement state.

requirements.title: Florida Real Estate Tests Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the Florida real estate test materials.
requirements.boundary_note: This proofreading deliverable is independent of the CHPN and other proofreading assignments and has its own completion evidence.

requirements.title: NASM CPT Heading Correction and Proofreading
requirements.definition: Correct the headings and proofread the originally assigned NASM CPT material.
requirements.boundary_note: Heading correction and proofreading are retained as one tightly coupled editing task because the client explicitly presents them as one NASM CPT assignment and cancels them together.

requirements.title: Initial NASM CPT Image Addition
requirements.definition: Add images to the initially assigned, separately prepared NASM CPT material.
requirements.boundary_note: This cancelled image assignment is distinct from the later new-file assignment because the client identifies it as separate material and later introduces a new NASM CPT file after cancellation.

requirements.title: New NASM CPT File Image Addition
requirements.definition: Add images to the new NASM CPT file only at Heading 2 subheadings.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a newly introduced deliverable after the earlier NASM image task was cancelled; the Heading 2 restriction is an attribute of this specific task.

requirements.title: ALEKS Math Placement Study Guide
requirements.definition: Create ALEKS math placement review material using the specified 900-word, direct paragraph-based format, with no introduction or conclusion and only one bullet per prompt.
requirements.boundary_note: Word count, prose style, structural omissions, and bullet usage are acceptance attributes of one study-guide artifact rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: LCSW Audiobook Formatting
requirements.boundary_note: This is a standalone formatting deliverable; its deadline is administrative and is excluded from Requirement attributes.

requirements.title: Canada Citizenship Guide Proofreading
requirements.definition: Proofread the designated Canada citizenship guide version and add new proofreading comments rather than relying on comments already present in the document.
requirements.boundary_note: Selection of the September 12 document and treatment of pre-existing comments are attributes of this proofreading deliverable; generated-image checking is handled by a separate image-quality Requirement.

requirements.title: M1 Motorcycle Material Proofreading
requirements.boundary_note: The surrounding schedule resolves the otherwise referential introduction as an independent M1 motorcycle proofreading assignment.

requirements.title: Ontario Driver's License Book Image Addition
requirements.definition: Generate and insert images for the subheadings in the Ontario driver's license book.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement owns delivery of the Ontario book's images; cross-book chapter coverage and generated-image spelling accuracy are independently testable standards and remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Image Coverage Beginning with Chapter 1
requirements.definition: Begin image generation at chapter 1 unless the client explicitly provides a book-specific exception.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a cross-book coverage rule that can fail or change independently of whether images are otherwise generated successfully; book-specific exceptions do not propagate globally.

requirements.title: Generated Image Spelling Accuracy
requirements.definition: Check each generated image for spelling errors and regenerate erroneous images before inserting corrected versions into the document.
requirements.boundary_note: The retained behavior is the independently verifiable spelling-quality and regeneration rule during image generation; the prescribed seven-minute review duration is workflow effort rather than an artifact requirement.

requirements.title: NASM Tests 5–9 Question Spacing
requirements.definition: Correct question-spacing problems in NASM tests 5 through 9.
requirements.boundary_note: Question-spacing correction directly changes the document artifact. The accompanying generic PDF check is excluded as a QA activity because no independent executable artifact or distinct required correction is specified.

requirements.title: Texas Driver's License Study Guide
requirements.definition: Create Texas driver's license review material using the specified 750-word, direct paragraph-based format with appropriate tables and bullets and no introduction or conclusion.
requirements.boundary_note: Length, style, tables, bullets, and omitted introductory and concluding sections are attributes of one independently delivered study guide.
